Generation stores candidates without","changing live content. The Variants section supports naming, preview, refinement,","per-node accept/reject, application, and removal. Refinement advances just that","variant's head and resets its review decisions. Previous generated revisions","remain retained.","","`DiagramVariant` in `domain/core/diagrams/diagramVariant.ts` stores:","","- `diagramId`, `contentId`, and `ownerNodeId`: logical ownership; `root` denotes","  the complete diagram without requiring an extra visible ASCII node.","- `baseRevisionId`, `headRevisionId`, and `revisionIds`: immutable source,","  current candidate, and retained generated revisions.","- `decisions`: accept/reject keyed by stable logical node identity.","- `appliedRevisionId` and `appliedReview`: the last application and the exact","  candidate/decisions used, so later review changes can reverse prior changes.","- `id`, `name`, and `prompt`: the independently editable alternative's metadata.","","Variants live in `MappingGridDocument.variants`. The checkpoint codec stores each","variant under its own `document/variants` record boundary. `checkpointRevisionIds`","includes variant references as well as current placements, so detached candidates","survive workspace persistence, checkpoint publication, undo/redo, and ChangeSession","fork/acceptance. Variant-only proposal edits appear as document changes. Removing","a variant leaves ordinary retained history available; it does not erase history.","","### Continuity protocol","","`diagramEditRuntime.ts` supplies the generator with the base revision's `nodeRefs`","and requests `[[keep:logical-node-id]]` suffixes for retained nodes, including","renamed or moved nodes. `diagramNodeContinuity.ts` validates and strips these","annotations before source mapping validation and persistence. Unknown IDs,","duplicate claims, and claims that do not identify exactly one output node fail.","The selected subtree root must retain its logical ID. No label-matching heuristic","establishes identity.","","`DiagramRevisionEditor` accepts the validated correspondence for both replacement","and patch operations. Unchanged lines outside a patch retain their existing","identities. `DiagramService` issues all revisions and IDs; reviewed application","uses `derive` to preserve proven identities from the base, candidate, and current","revision. Controller reconciliation uses that correspondence to retain connections,","highlights, selection identity, and folded branches during variant application.","","### Selective application and rollback","","`variantChanges` compares labels, parents, and ordered children by stable node ID.","Pending and rejected changes retain the base state; accepted changes use the","candidate state. Additions, deletions, and moves can require matching parent/child","decisions. The review UI reports inconsistent structural decisions and blocks","application until they agree.","","`applyVariant` performs a three-way merge into the current subtree. Label, parent,","and child-list fields merge separately. Unrelated edits elsewhere, including","unrelated fields inside the subtree, are preserved. A competing edit to a field","being changed raises `VARIANT_CONFLICT`. No-content-conflict applications preserve","existing formatting when topology is unchanged; structural changes render the","reviewed subtree using canonical ASCII connectors and leave surrounding lines","untouched. After applying, change decisions and apply again to reverse selected","updates, subject to the same conflict checks. Undo/redo includes variant metadata","and applications.","","The generation API's `variant: {name, count, variantId?}` option supports new","alternatives or refinement of one saved alternative. The canvas API provides","`nodes.variants({nodeId})` and `nodes.reviewVariant({nodeId, variantId, decisions?,","name?, remove?, apply?})`. Review mutations use the existing expected-version,","request deduplication, batching, and persistence mechanisms."],"symbol":"Generated variants and node continuity"}]},"variants-b054943a-boundaries":{"id":"variants-b054943a-boundaries","sourceId":"source-variants-b054943a","handle":"Current boundaries","label":"Current boundaries","category":"operation","summary":"Source pinned to commit b054943aef9f21281cb7d0ee35fe5c0aa700cb15 (2026-10-22), feat: generate and review persistent subtree variants with node continuity. Root application also uses review/merge; it is not a simple revision pointer swap.","sourceRanges":[{"id":"variants-b054943a-review-range","path":"domain/core/diagrams/diagramVariant.ts","startLine":69,"endLine":127,"originalLines":["export function variantChanges(base: DiagramRevision, candidate: DiagramRevision, owner: string): VariantChange[] {","  if (base.diagramId !== candidate.diagramId || base.diagram.content.structure.kind !== candidate.diagram.content.structure.kind) throw Error('Variant must preserve diagram identity and structure kind');","  const before = scopedTree(base, owner), after = scopedTree(candidate, owner);","  return [...new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(after)])].filter(id => !same(before[id], after[id])).map(id => ({","    id, label: id === rootId ? 'Subtree structure / content' : after[id]?.label ?? before[id].label,","    kind: !before[id] ? 'added' : !after[id] ? 'removed' : 'updated', before: before[id], after: after[id]","  }));","}","function checkTree(tree: Tree) {","  const visited = new Set<string>();","  const visit = (id: string, parentId?: string, depth = 0) => {","    const node = tree[id];","    if (!node || visited.has(id) || node.parentId !== parentId || depth > 100) throw Error('REVIEW_DEPENDENCY: accept or reject the related parent, child and move changes together');","    visited.add(id); node.childIds.forEach(child => visit(child, id, depth + 1));","  };","  visit(rootId);","  if (visited.size !== Object.keys(tree).length) throw Error('REVIEW_DEPENDENCY: a retained node would be disconnected; review its parent change');","}","function approvedTree(variant: DiagramVariant, base: DiagramRevision, candidate: DiagramRevision) {","  const result = structuredClone(scopedTree(base, variant.ownerNodeId));","  for (const change of variantChanges(base, candidate, variant.ownerNodeId)) if (variant.decisions[change.id] === 'accept') {","    if (change.after) result[change.id] = structuredClone(change.after); else delete result[change.id];","  }","  checkTree(result); return result;","}","export function reviewVariant(variant: DiagramVariant, get: (id: string) => DiagramRevision) {","  const base = get(variant.baseRevisionId), candidate = get(variant.headRevisionId);","  const changes = variantChanges(base, candidate, variant.ownerNodeId);","  let error: string | undefined;","  try { approvedTree(variant, base, candidate); } catch (e) { error = String(e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); }","  const scopeLabel = variant.ownerNodeId === 'root' ? 'Whole diagram'","    : diagramContentNodes(base.diagram.content).find(node => base.nodeRefs[node.id] === variant.ownerNodeId)?.label ?? 'Subtree';","  return { changes, error, scopeLabel, ascii: candidate.diagram.content.ascii };","}","","/** Three-way application touches only changed logical nodes in the chosen subtree. */","export function applyVariant(variant: DiagramVariant, current: DiagramRevision, diagrams: DiagramService) {","  validateVariant(variant, id => diagrams.getRevision(id));","  if (current.diagramId !== variant.diagramId || current.diagram.id !== variant.contentId) throw Error('Variant belongs to another diagram');","  const base = diagrams.getRevision(variant.baseRevisionId), candidate = diagrams.getRevision(variant.headRevisionId);","  const desired = approvedTree(variant, base, candidate);","  const before = variant.appliedReview ? approvedTree({ ...variant, ...variant.appliedReview }, base, diagrams.getRevision(variant.appliedReview.headRevisionId)) : scopedTree(base, variant.ownerNodeId);","  const live = scopedTree(current, variant.ownerNodeId), merged = structuredClone(live);","  for (const id of new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(desired)])) {","    if (same(before[id], desired[id])) continue;","    // Fields merge separately, so a label review does not overwrite newly added children.","    const from = before[id], to = desired[id], now = live[id];","    if (from && to && now) {","      for (const field of ['label', 'parentId', 'childIds'] as const) if (!same(from[field], to[field])) {","        if (!same(now[field], from[field]) && !same(now[field], to[field])) throw Error(`VARIANT_CONFLICT: ${now.label} changed since this review`);","        (merged[id] as any)[field] = structuredClone(to[field]);","      }","    } else {","      if (!same(now, from) && !same(now, to)) throw Error(`VARIANT_CONFLICT: ${to?.label ?? from?.label ?? id} changed since this review`);","      if (to) merged[id] = structuredClone(to); else delete merged[id];","    }","  }","  checkTree(merged);","  if (same(merged, live)) return { diagram: current.diagram, revision: current, nodeIds: new Map(Object.keys(current.nodeRefs).map(id => [id, id])) };"],"symbol":"variantChanges / applyVariant"}]},"variants-b054943a-render":{"id":"variants-b054943a-render","sourceId":"source-variants-b054943a","handle":"applyVariant subtree rendering and mappings","label":"applyVariant subtree rendering and mappings","category":"operation","summary":"Source pinned to commit b054943aef9f21281cb7d0ee35fe5c0aa700cb15 (2026-10-22), feat: generate and review persistent subtree variants with node continuity. Preserves untouched surrounding lines, proven identities and compatible source mappings when deriving the reviewed revision.","sourceRanges":[{"id":"variants-b054943a-render-range","path":"domain/core/diagrams/diagramVariant.ts","startLine":128,"endLine":186,"originalLines":["  const range = variantRange(current, variant.ownerNodeId), oldLines = current.diagram.content.ascii.split('\\n');","  const lines: string[] = [], refs: Record<string, number> = {};","  const sameTopology = Object.keys(merged).length === Object.keys(live).length && Object.entries(merged).every(([id, node]) =>","    live[id] && node.parentId === live[id].parentId && same(node.childIds, live[id].childIds));","  if (current.diagram.content.structure.kind === 'diagram' || merged[rootId].label) lines.push(...merged[rootId].label.split('\\n'));","  else if (sameTopology) {","    lines.push(...oldLines.slice(range.startLine - 1, range.endLine));","    for (const node of diagramContentNodes(current.diagram.content)) {","      const ref = current.nodeRefs[node.id];","      if (!merged[ref]) continue;","      const index = node.line - range.startLine;","      lines[index] = lines[index].slice(0, node.startColumn - 1) + merged[ref].label + lines[index].slice(node.endColumn);","      refs[ref] = node.line;","    }","  } else {","    const nodeLines = new Set(diagramContentNodes(current.diagram.content).map(node => node.line));","    if (oldLines.slice(range.startLine - 1, range.endLine).some((line, index) =>","      !nodeLines.has(range.startLine + index) && /[^ |+`\\-]/.test(line)))","      throw Error('VARIANT_LAYOUT: structural review cannot safely reposition non-node text; make that text a tree node first');","    const root = diagramContentNodes(current.diagram.content).find(n => current.nodeRefs[n.id] === variant.ownerNodeId);","    const rootPrefix = root ? oldLines[root.line - 1].slice(0, root.startColumn - 1) : '';","    const render = (id: string, prefix: string, childPrefix: string) => {","      refs[id] = range.startLine + lines.length;","      lines.push(prefix + merged[id].label);","      merged[id].childIds.forEach((child, i, all) => render(child, childPrefix + (i === all.length - 1 ? '    ' : '|   ')));","    };","    const branchWidth = root ? root.startColumn - 1 - root.branchColumn : 0;","    const childPrefix = root && root.branchColumn >= 0 ? rootPrefix.slice(0, root.branchColumn)","      + (rootPrefix[root.branchColumn] === '`' ? ' '.repeat(branchWidth) : '|' + ' '.repeat(Math.max(0, branchWidth - 1))) : rootPrefix;","    merged[rootId].childIds.forEach(id => render(id, rootPrefix, childPrefix));","  }","  const ascii = [...oldLines.slice(0, range.startLine - 1), ...lines, ...oldLines.slice(range.endLine)].join('\\n');","  const delta = lines.length - (range.endLine - range.startLine + 1);","  for (const node of diagramContentNodes(current.diagram.content)) if (node.line < range.startLine || node.line > range.endLine)","    refs[current.nodeRefs[node.id]] = node.line + (node.line > range.endLine ? delta : 0);","  // Source mappings are retained only where their label-relative span still denotes the same text.","  const outputLines = ascii.split('\\n'), mappings: any[] = [], ids = new Set<string>();","  for (const revision of [current, candidate, base]) {","    const nodes = diagramContentNodes(revision.diagram.content), sourceLines = revision.diagram.content.ascii.split('\\n');","    for (const mapping of revision.diagram.sourceContext.mappings) {","      if (ids.has(mapping.id)) continue;","      const node = nodes.find(n => n.line === mapping.line && mapping.startColumn >= n.startColumn && mapping.endColumn <= n.endColumn);","      const ref = node && revision.nodeRefs[node.id], line = ref && refs[ref];","      if (!node || !line) continue;","      const text = sourceLines[mapping.line - 1].slice(mapping.startColumn - 1, mapping.endColumn);","      const label = merged[ref!]?.label ?? node.label, labelStart = outputLines[line - 1].lastIndexOf(label);","      const startColumn = labelStart + 1 + mapping.startColumn - node.startColumn, endColumn = startColumn + text.length - 1;","      if (labelStart < 0 || outputLines[line - 1].slice(startColumn - 1, endColumn) !== text) continue;","      ids.add(mapping.id); mappings.push({ ...mapping, line, startColumn, endColumn });","    }","  }","  const result = diagrams.derive(current.id, { ascii, structureKind: current.diagram.content.structure.kind,","    source: current.diagram.sourceContext.binding, evidence: { ...base.diagram.sourceContext.evidence, ...candidate.diagram.sourceContext.evidence, ...current.diagram.sourceContext.evidence }, mappings },","    refs, [current.id, base.id, candidate.id]);","  const rendered = scopedTree(result.revision, variant.ownerNodeId);","  if (Object.keys(rendered).length !== Object.keys(merged).length || Object.entries(merged).some(([id, node]) => !same(node, rendered[id])))","    throw Error('VARIANT_LAYOUT: the reviewed structure cannot be represented safely in this diagram');","  return result;","}"],"symbol":"applyVariant subtree rendering and mappings"}]},"variants-b054943a-markers":{"id":"variants-b054943a-markers","sourceId":"source-variants-b054943a","handle":"stripNodeContinuity","label":"stripNodeContinuity","category":"operation","summary":"Source pinned to commit b054943aef9f21281cb7d0ee35fe5c0aa700cb15 (2026-10-22), feat: generate and review persistent subtree variants with node continuity. Validates known and unique logical identity suffixes and strips them from persisted ASCII.","sourceRanges":[{"id":"variants-b054943a-markers-range","path":"domain/core/diagrams/diagramNodeContinuity.ts","startLine":1,"endLine":15,"originalLines":["/** Generator-only annotations. Persisted ASCII never contains identity markers. */","export function stripNodeContinuity(ascii: string, nodeRefs: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) {","  const known = new Set(Object.values(nodeRefs)), correspondence: Record<string, number> = {};","  const lines = ascii.split('\\n').map((line, index) => {","    if (!line.includes('[[keep:')) return line;","    const match = /\\s*\\[\\[keep:([^\\]\\s]+)\\]\\]\\s*$/.exec(line);","    if (!match || line.slice(0, match.index).includes('[[keep:')) throw Error('CONTINUITY: use one identity suffix per node line');","    const id = match[1];","    if (!known.has(id)) throw Error(`CONTINUITY: unknown logical node ${id}`);","    if (Object.hasOwn(correspondence, id)) throw Error(`CONTINUITY: duplicate logical node ${id}`);","    correspondence[id] = index + 1;","    return line.slice(0, match.index);","  });","  return { ascii: lines.join('\\n'), nodeCorrespondence: correspondence };","}"],"symbol":"stripNodeContinuity"}]},"variants-b054943a-identity":{"id":"variants-b054943a-identity","sourceId":"source-variants-b054943a","handle":"DiagramRevisionEditor.correspondence","label":"DiagramRevisionEditor.correspondence","category":"operation","summary":"Source pinned to commit b054943aef9f21281cb7d0ee35fe5c0aa700cb15 (2026-10-22), feat: generate and review persistent subtree variants with node continuity.
